🏢 Multi-Tenant Hierarchy

Employer (Tenant Root)

Namespace: Hqy.Employer.Domain.Entities
Role: Multi-tenant root entity
Scope: Contains all members, plans, accounts

⬇️ One-to-Many

Member (Belongs to Employer)

Namespace: Hqy.Employer.Domain.Entities
Role: Employee/participant in benefits program
Scope: Can have multiple reimbursement accounts

⬇️ One-to-Many

ReimbursementAccount (Belongs to Member)

Namespace: Hqy.Employer.Domain.Entities
Role: FSA/HSA/HRA account instance
Scope: Linked to a plan, contains balances, claims, transactions

🎯 Business Capability Mapping

Account Management

Service: ReimbursementAccountBalanceService
Entities: ReimbursementAccount, Balance, Transaction, Contribution
Purpose: Create, update, deactivate accounts; manage balances

Claims Processing

Service: ReimbursementAccountBalanceService
Entities: Claim, ClaimLine, Reimbursement, Document, Card, CardTransaction
Purpose: Submit claims, approve/deny, disburse reimbursements

Year-End Processing

Services: CarryoverDollarsDomainService, CarryoverSharedService, RolloverSettingsService
Entities: BalanceChangeAudit, CarryoverTransferTracking, ForfeitureRule, CarryoverRule
Purpose: EOFY carryover calculation, forfeiture processing, audit trail

Plan Management

Service: PercentPlanLedgerDomainService
Entities: ReimbursementPlan, PlanType, PlanYear, PercentPlanLedger
Purpose: Configure plans, manage plan years, ledger tracking

🔒 Compliance Entity Highlighting

🟡 Audit Trail Entities (IRS Compliance)

BalanceChangeAudit: Tracks all balance modifications (7-year retention)
CarryoverTransferTracking: Records year-end carryover transfers
AuditLog: System-level access and operation logging

🔴 PCI-DSS Scope Entities (Payment Card Data)

Card: Debit card numbers (requires encryption/tokenization)
CardTransaction: Transaction details (secure transmission required)

🔵 HIPAA Protected Entities (PHI)

Member: Personal demographics (name, SSN, DOB)
Claim: Medical claim details (diagnosis codes, procedure codes)
Document: Uploaded receipts (may contain PHI)

🔗 Entity Relationships

Relationship Type Example Cardinality Notes
One-to-Many Employer → Members 1:N One employer has many members
One-to-Many Member → ReimbursementAccounts 1:N One member can have multiple accounts (FSA, HSA, etc.)
Many-to-One ReimbursementAccounts → ReimbursementPlan N:1 Many accounts share the same plan
One-to-Many ReimbursementAccount → Claims 1:N One account has many claims
One-to-Many Claim → ClaimLines 1:N One claim has multiple line items
One-to-One ReimbursementAccount → Card 1:1 (optional) Optional debit card per account
Many-to-Many Member ↔ BenefitElections N:M Members can have multiple benefit elections across plan years
